title: Framer Site Plan Comparison
capture_type: Authored sanitized observation excerpts, not raw provider logs
observations: Yearly default: Basic CA$14, Pro CA$41 per month billed yearly. Additional editors CA$27 per month.
Monthly switch: Basic CA$20, Pro CA$60, additional editors CA$40 per month. Restored yearly.
Basic: 1,000 monthly credits, 2 CMS collections, 50 GB bandwidth, 30 site pages, password protect, localization add-on.
Pro: everything in Basic, 3,000 credits, 10 CMS collections, 100 GB bandwidth, 150 site pages, Branching, Staging, A/B testing and Advanced hosting add-ons.
Free custom domain and 2x credits first month display Annual only in monthly view.
Enterprise Custom, Annual only, custom limits, unlimited editors, uptime guarantee, enterprise security, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, SCIM, SSO and Request trial.
limitations: No Subscribe or Request trial action used. Prices are a CA$ UI snapshot from 2026-10-07, not a current offer or verified invoice.
Provider screenshots remain session-only. No durable screenshot file or network trace is attached.
Local JSX, CSS, state changes and test results are reconstruction evidence, not provider implementation.
